name: The Hang Seng University of Hong Kong
summary: Sha Tin residential university of about 6,700 students; an IB Diploma of 24 points with 12 from HL opens year-one entry.

ib.text: IB Diploma of 24 points (three HL and three SL subjects, 12 or more from HL). English is shown by an IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 70 result; Actuarial Studies needs Maths grade 5. Most modules are taught in English.

programmes.name: Actuarial Studies and Insurance
programmes.about: An actuarial degree that combines actuarial science with business and insurance education, building data analytics, investment and financial analysis skills and preparing you for professional exams along the way.
programmes.ib: Maths grade 5 at SL or HL on top of the school's 24-point rule; shortlisted applicants may sit a written test or interview.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Interview performance, English proficiency and programme choices are weighed case by case.

flagshipSource.title: BSc in Actuarial Studies and Insurance: recognised by the Society of Actuaries and the Actuarial Society of HK

faculties.name: School of Business
faculties.line: BBA majors from accountancy to marketing; the general 24-point IB rule applies and an interview may follow.

faculties.name: School of Communication
faculties.line: Arts and Culture Communication, Convergent Media and Journalism and Communication; the general IB rule applies.

faculties.name: School of Decision Sciences
faculties.line: Supply chain, actuarial, computing and data science degrees; Actuarial Studies needs Maths grade 5.

faculties.name: School of Humanities and Social Science
faculties.line: Art and Design, Chinese, English, Psychology and social science degrees; the general IB rule applies.

faculties.name: School of Translation and Foreign Languages
faculties.line: Translation with Business; the general IB rule applies and a written test or interview may follow.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: non-local first-year tuition in 2026/27 was HK$153,820 for most programmes and HK$193,240 for Art and Design; the 2027/28 rates are not published yet.
Applications for 2027 entry are not dated yet: last year's non-local deadline was 10 June, so ask the admissions office and apply early.
Most modules are taught in English, but Chinese-language degrees such as BA Chinese are not, so check each programme.
